body:
"you're still learning, but you know enough. you still know nothing, but you know that you know nothing."

taylor, on being 22 — the year she called "my favorite year of my life." the song isn't a love song. it's a letter to her friends.

why: Calendar 2026-08-26 15:00Z X — slot is heartbeat:on-this-day with a heartbeat:track-fact(red) fallback, hook 'the real quote' (a sourced quote first, attribution second). DELIBERATELY USED THE RED TRACK-FACT FALLBACK, not the dated on-this-day match: the only clean Aug-26-dated Vault moment is red.mjs:702 (the 2013 VMAs Herve Leger gown, a fashion item) — it carries no quote so it can't serve the 'real quote' hook, and it would be the third VMA/red-fashion post in three days after 08-24's romper, against the ledger's spread-the-subjects steer. The other Aug-26 dated items are hard blocklist (2025-08-26 TTPD engagement, and the New Heights cluster — relationship/family) and were not considered. Source: supabase/seed/content/red.mjs:143 ('22, a birthday letter to her closest friends'), moment id vault-red-22-a-birthday-letter-to-her-closest-friends (verified in content-vault.generated.ts). Quoted line 'You're still learning... you know that you know nothing' and 'my favorite year of my life' are Taylor's SPOKEN interview descriptions (Songfacts/Ryan Seacrest per the dossier), NOT lyrics — the actual '22' lyric ('happy, free, confused and lonely') is deliberately NOT quoted, honoring the no-lyrics redline (docs/decisions.md 2026-07-09). Framing that it's 'a letter to her friends, not a love song' is straight from the dossier. Text-only (the correct X rung; no committed real photo of this fits and rehosted press photos are retired, docs/decisions.md 2026-08-15).
